data.name: Yunusiyat
data.long_meaning: A companion of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) in the whale's belly. This name signifies companionship with righteous people and the ability to endure through hardships.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the companionship of the righteous and the ability to endure through adversity.
data.numerology_meaning: Expression, creativity, and communication are the keynotes of this name. The name Yunusiyat is ideal for those who are expressive, creative, and enjoy sharing their ideas with the world.

in_arabic.name: يونسية
in_arabic.meaning: يونسية اسم مؤنث مشتق من يونس عليه السلام

in_hindi.name: यूनुसियात
in_hindi.meaning: यूनुसियात नाम यूसफ नबी से संबंधित है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यूनुसियात नाम का अर्थ है यूसफ नबी से संबंधित। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर बच्चों को दिया जाता है। यह नाम पश्चाताप और विश्वास के अर्थ में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.meaning: یونسۍ د یونس نبي څخه اخیستل شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: یونسۍ د یونس نبي څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د اسلام په دين کې ډېر مهم رول لري. دا نوم د توبې او ايمان په معنا کې کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Yunusiyat
in_english.meaning: Yunusiyat is a feminine name related to Prophet Yunus
in_english.long_meaning: Yunusiyat is a feminine given name derived from the name of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), an important figure in Islamic tradition. The name signifies repentance, faith, and remorse for sins. Prophet Yunus is mentioned in the Quran and his story serves as a lesson in faith and divine mercy

data.cultural_impact: The name "Yunusiyat" holds special significance in Islamic culture as it is associated with the beloved Prophet Yunus (Jonah). This name is a reminder of the great story of Prophet Yunus and his journey as mentioned in the Quran. The name carries the memory of this great companion and his unwavering faith in Allah's mercy and prompt response to repentance.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name "Yunusiyat" signifies companionship with the righteous in both this world and the hereafter. It serves as a reminder to always surround ourselves with good company, as mentioned in Hadith, "The example of a good companion (sahib) in comparison to a bad one is like that of the musk seller and the one who carries the bellows. The effect of the one who carries the bellows reaches as far as the one who sells musk does" [Sahih Muslim]. Furthermore, the name echoes the experiences of Prophet Yunus, which can be seen as an analogy for the trials and hardships we all face in life. The name is a reminder that through faith and patience, we can endure these hardships and emerge more spiritually enriched.
